test_dropna_rows_with_any_nan: test DataFrame.dropna() to drop rows containing any NaN values
test_dropna_rows_all_nan: test DataFrame.dropna(how='all') to drop rows where all values are NaN
test_dropna_columns: test DataFrame.dropna(axis=1) to drop columns containing NaN values
test_dropna_threshold: test DataFrame.dropna(thresh=N) to keep rows or columns with at least N non-NaN values
test_dropna_subset: test DataFrame.dropna(subset=[...]) to drop rows based on NaN in specific columns
